summary.text: Valoree Swanson is a Republican member of the Texas House of Representatives who has represented District 150 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Valoree Swanson first assumed office in the Texas House in 2017, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.

Her committee assignments have included Elections and Human Services in 2017, Elections and Urban Affairs in 2019-2020, Elections, Resolutions Calendars and Juvenile Justice & Family Issues (as vice chair) in 2021-2022, and Corrections and Elections in 2023-2024.
Ballotpedia, quoting her 2016 campaign website, lists pro-life policy, border security and immigration, Second Amendment rights, and property values and rights among the issues she highlighted.
